evals.prompt: Does Yale University Library have Chinese books with 明史 in the title? Show the oldest ones and where they are shelved.
evals.expected_output: Alma SRU title search at Yale for 明史, Chinese language, oldest first, with vernacular titles and AVA call numbers
expectations: The Alma SRU endpoint was queried (yale.alma.exlibrisgroup.com/view/sru)
The title index was searched for 明史, with language chi
Results were sorted by date ascending, with unknown dates excluded or noted
Titles are shown in Chinese characters (from 880 fields)
Call numbers and locations from AVA fields are given
The library's public website was not scraped

evals.prompt: Find books by Jonathan D. Spence at Yale and tell me which ones I can read online.
evals.expected_output: Author search with AVE electronic holdings identified
expectations: Results separate print (AVA) from online (AVE) holdings

evals.prompt: I found OCLC number 424023 in WorldCat. Does Yale hold it, and is there a digitized copy?
evals.expected_output: OCLC lookup in Yale Alma, then HathiTrust check
expectations: The record title and holdings are reported
The hathitrust-catalog skill or HathiTrust API was used for the digitized-copy question

evals.prompt: Does Yale have any artworks or objects by Wen Zhengming 文徵明? Search across its museums and libraries.
evals.expected_output: LUX search for Wen Zhengming in the item scope, with summaries
expectations: The agent or item scope was used with Wen Zhengming or 文徵明
Results show object labels and types, and links where available
